data.title: Loupes
data.summary: Diagnostic · Binocular magnifying devices (about 2-4x) worn during examination and surgery.
data.body:
![Loupes](instruments/loupes.jpg)

_Also called: Surgical loupes, Binocular magnifier, Head loupe_

Binocular magnifying devices (about 2-4x) worn during examination and surgery.

## Types / variants
- Head-band and spectacle-mounted
- Magnification about 2x to 4x

## Uses / indications
- Better visualisation for suturing and spotting bleeding points
- Biopsy, excision, hair transplant and reconstructive surgery
- Better posture and less eye strain in long procedures
